Closed at 6ec0c47 (slices a892b5c core rezoom, 80841b6 navigator + region select, 6ec0c47 browser).

Acceptance evidence, exact SHA 6ec0c47 (clean worktree build):
- Re-windowing never recompiles: RezoomSuite (counting Stat stays at 1 call; PhaseClock shows 0 Mapping/Stat/ScaleTraining calls); browser check asserts statCalls unchanged across wheel, pan, pinch, zoom-to-area.
- Ranges/ticks equal a fresh compile at the window on linear, log10 and date axes (RezoomSuite oracle); panel frame fixed.
- Region selection: band, Shift-add, Alt-subtract and lasso match an independent centre oracle (JVM/JS DataWindowNavigatorSuite; browser vs DOM-independent mark centres); Escape abandons a drag.
- Navigation: wheel zoom holds the pointer's data; page scrolls when unfocused, or zooming out of full view; Ctrl/Meta +/-/0 left to browser; pan holds grabbed data and clamps; zoom to area lands exactly on rectangle edges (log axis); date ticks preserved; burst of 5 wheel events composes to exp(-1) with one redraw; drawn DOM circles match oracle after zoom; navigate() validated/normalized; zoom floor on date axes.
- Touch: CDP real two-finger pinch in Inspect mode zooms the plot, page scale stays 1; negative control (touch-action:manipulation) page zooms to 2.84x -> check fails.
- Magnification scales marks+text (2x), navigation does not.
Gates: testAll 15 targets / 1,989 tests green; tools/check-compatibility.sh green (MiMa forward/backward, 11 TASTy, calibration); links resolve. Playwright Chromium 151.0.7922.34: navigation 15/15, widget 16/16, linked 11/11.
Two independent fresh-context reviews; all findings fixed or documented.

Stated gaps (docs/browser-widget.md "Known limits"): window cannot reach the compiled expansion margin (core zoom resolver refuses out-of-domain windows); MarkInk framing only in the full view; update() resets the window; narrow log windows show power-of-ten ticks only (bd-01M3ZMXMZJPVBZP7NX7AAGK8VX); intaglio-interaction artifact has no forward additive review in the compat gate (pre-existing scope). Docs gate fails only on another lane's uncommitted gallery plates.
